description: Find HUD LIHTC properties whose placed-in-service year reaches the federal 15-year reference date in an exact window. Returns source project fields, unit counts, and a clearly labeled screening date. Use this for 'LIHTC projects reaching year 15 in 2027'. Year 15 is not proof that affordability restrictions expire; extended-use rules vary by state and property documents, so this is not legal, compliance, or investment advice.
